title: Finite quotient reduction preserves the finite constructible categories
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $r\geq m\geq1$, $A_r=\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z$ and $A_m=\mathbf Z/\ell^m\mathbf Z$. Let $T$ be a scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-pc-scheme]. Write $C_T=\nu_T^*$ for the comparison from the ordinary etale to the pro-etale derived category [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Let $K$ have bounded intrinsically constructible cohomology [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf] and Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$, where $a\leq b$ are integers [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. Let $K_0$ be a bounded constructible ordinary-etale complex with a specified isomorphism $C_TK_0\cong K$ [lem-weil-pbc-finite-ring-constructible-derived-origin]. Then $K_0$ has Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ and has a representative $Q$ consisting of flat etale $A_r$-module sheaves, zero outside $[a,b]$. Both $Q$ over $A_r$ and $Q\otimes_{A_r}A_m$ over $A_m$ are K-flat (tensoring with them preserves acyclic complexes). The latter represents $K_0\otimes^L_{A_r}A_m$ and is zero outside $[a,b]$. The complex $K\otimes^L_{A_r}A_m$ has bounded intrinsically constructible cohomology and Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ over $A_m$, and its bounded constructible ordinary-etale origin is $K_0\otimes^L_{A_r}A_m$, through the canonical comparison
$$C_T(K_0\otimes^L_{A_r}A_m)\cong K\otimes^L_{A_r}A_m.$$
For $r\geq m\geq n\geq1$, these comparisons commute with the derived tensor associator; on the flat model the associator is $(q\otimes b)\otimes c\mapsto q\otimes bc$. No flatness of $A_m$ over $A_r$ is assumed.
